description: This file defines the UserRoles class within the Goteo project, responsible for handling user permissions, roles, and their persistence in a MySQL database. It includes methods for managing roles, permissions, and querying role data associated with user objects.

classes.name: UserRoles
classes.description: Class for handling and managing user roles and permissions, extending ArrayObject for role storage and providing methods to modify, query, and persist roles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a UserRoles instance for a given user, ensuring the user has at least the 'user' role.

methods.name: getAllRoleNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all role names, excluding the 'root' role.

methods.name: getRoleName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of a role based on a key.

methods.name: getPermName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of a permission based on a key.

methods.name: getRolePerms
methods.description: Returns permissions associated with a specific role ID.

methods.name: getRolesForUser
methods.description: Fetches roles assigned to a specific user from the database.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a role to the user if it exists and is not already assigned; throws exception if role is 'root'.

methods.name: removeRole
methods.description: Removes a role from the user unless it is the 'user' role, which cannot be removed.

methods.name: getRoleNames
methods.description: Returns a list of role names for the user.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current roles of the user to the database, replacing previous role associations.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has one or more specified roles.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of a specified role.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if the user has any role with a higher level than the specified role.

methods.name: atLeast
methods.description: Checks if the user has a role with level greater than or equal to the specified role.

methods.name: hasPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has one or more permissions, optionally verifying model-specific assignment.

methods.name: userAssignedInModel
methods.description: Internal method to verify if a user has a permission within a relational model context.

methods.name: assignUserPerm
methods.description: Assigns a specific permission to a user for a given model instance, handling join or direct table relations.
